messages:
Jordan: FYI starting canary for auriga12b-v2-int4 on pool-18. Seeing OOMs on long-document summarization and a small comp-quality regression (~1.7 ROUGE). Node shows kv alloc failures and high slot fragmentation.
Kira: What runtime flags are in use? prefetch / windowing / max_new_tokens / slot_reserve?
Jordan: defaults: prefetch=true, generation_windowing=off, microbatch=4, slot_reserve=0.05, max_new_tokens=400. Failures around 600-850 generated tokens. Log snippet: `ERROR kv_alloc failed used=12.3GB free=0.38GB slot_frag=0.29`
Sanjay: slot_frag 0.29 suggests fragmentation. Two quick mitigations: 1) prefetch=false + cap max_new_tokens=150; 2) keep prefetch but enable `freelist_slack=0.08` and `kv_lane_pool=2` to reduce per-request allocator churn. Which to run first?
Jordan: I'll try #1 first — quick canary. Triggering: `curl -X POST https://canary/api/serve -d '{"model":"auriga12b-v2-int4","opts":{"prefetch":false,"max_new_tokens":150}}'` (job 5167894330).
mercury-bot: Canary deploy started for auriga12b-v2-int4 on pool-18 (job 5167894330)
Kira: Also spin up an A/B eval (500 prompts) comparing v2-int4 vs hybrid-int8-attn (int8 for attention/kv) to check if quant is the quality source. If hybrid recovers ROUGE, focus on per-channel scale recalibration.
Jordan: Pasted allocator excerpt from failing node:
```
ERROR OOM kv_alloc
used=12.3GB free=0.38GB slot_frag=0.29
allocator: freelist_sweep=7 compact_ops=0
backtrace: ...
```
Sanjay: The zero compacts is telling. Medium-term we should enable `compact_on_evict=true` and add a background defrag sweep during idle windows. Also consider a kernel hotpatch that adds a `freelist_defrag_threshold` tunable.
Jordan: Canary update: after disabling prefetch and capping max_new_tokens=150 we've run ~2.4k requests with zero OOMs. Latency p50 +10-16ms, cost +6-9%. Starting the hybrid-int8 AB now (job 5167894345).
Kira: Great. If hybrid-int8 matches float quality, propose a staged rollout: defaults for auriga12b-prod stay int4 but with `max_new_tokens=150`, `prefetch=false` for 48h. In parallel, test `kv_lane_pool=2` + `freelist_slack=0.08` + `compact_on_evict=true` on canary to see if we can relax defaults later.
Sanjay: Add automated gates: rollback if OOM_rate > 0.04% across pool-18 or ROUGE drops >1.2 pts on summarization eval. Also capture `nvidia-smi` and allocator traces on any OOM.
Jordan: Will add the alerts and telemetry. If the hybrid AB shows a small quality win (~<0.5 pts), I'd prefer trying per-channel recalibration on q/k/v projections first before hybrid fallback.
Kira: One more experiment: try `generation_windowing=200` + `batch_pacing=low` with microbatch=1 to see if aggressive kv flush helps fragmentation without dropping quality too much. We should only run that if hybrid/int8 doesn't fix it.
Jordan: Noted. Posting the AB numbers and kv_lane experiment results tomorrow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
